text:
The tenth Creole -jalón of the continente,
puntal of it indohispano- of espíritu is llena.


of autoctonía vasta, of espíritu potente,
corre for nuestras zonas of planta, mar and arena.
Propio is his contenido, propio is his continente.


The tenth is caliente, the tenth is morena;
and uña of gato and diente of perro juntamente
brinda cuando, with rústicos instrumentos, resuena.
to the cuerpo, that is flexible, the gracia is him anuda.


Pica si is sazona, quema si is desnuda.
Pegando or requiriendo, the tenth is of bríos.


are ácidos and sweet the jugos of his entraña;
and in my país, vestida of sol and miel, huraña
and amante, is da in sombra of tierras and bohíos.


Suma of eternidades, tus legados
ofrecen, for the gracias enhebrados,
the más nobles decires in his estilo.

translation.title: The tenth Creole
